newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close firm on soybean gains.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close firm on soybean gains.

text.p: A late rally in nearby soybean contracts boosted CBOT soy product futures to a firmer close, traders said.
The market was pressed early by a drop in the Dow industrial stock average, and that discouraged buyers in soy products.
The Dow fell 50 points early, triggering index-arbitrage trading curbs on the New York Stock Exchange. The Dow then recouped a portion of the early losses and closed 19 lower at 6529.
Position squaring was noted before Friday, first notice day for deliveries on the December contracts.
Merrill Lynch Futures was a noted spreader of 1,000 lots of December/January soyoil, the traders said.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 17,000 contracts, below the 20,446 traded Monday. Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 16,000 contracts, below the 20,211 traded Monday.
Soymeal closed $1.00 per ton higher to $0.70 lower, with December up $0.60 at $237.50. Soyoil was unchanged to 0.15 cent per lb higher, with December unchanged at 23.31.
